bei.crafting.note.map_cloning: Combine a filled map with empty maps to copy it.
bei.crafting.note.map_extending: Surround a filled map with paper to zoom it out.
bei.crafting.note.map_upgrading: Combine a map with a compass to turn it into a locator map that shows player markers.
bei.crafting.note.map_locking: Combine a filled map with a glass pane to lock it.
bei.crafting.note.book_cloning: Combine a written book with books and quills to copy it.
bei.crafting.note.banner_duplicate: Copies the pattern of a banner onto a blank banner of the same color.
bei.crafting.note.banner_add_pattern: Arrange dyes around a banner to add a pattern.
bei.crafting.note.firework_star: Add dyes and optional effect items (diamond, glowstone dust, feather, gold nugget, head...) to choose the explosion.
bei.crafting.note.firework_rocket: Use 1 to 3 gunpowder for longer flights; firework stars are optional.
bei.crafting.note.decorated_pot: Any mix of bricks and pottery sherds; each sherd decorates one side.
bei.crafting.note.shield: Applies a banner's pattern to a shield.
